headline: Bias, prejudice, discrimination · 05:50

items.title: 05:50 · Allport observed in 1954 that people whose
items.detail: Allport observed in 1954 that people whose prejudice is habitual resist correcting their generalization even when exposed to strong contradictory facts.

items.title: 05:59 · When encountered with an individual who contradicts
items.detail: When encountered with an individual who contradicts the group stereotype, the prejudiced mind fences that person off as an isolated exception while keeping the generalization intact.

06:16 · Susan Fiske synthesized the standard tripartite model
items.detail: Susan Fiske synthesized the standard tripartite model in the 1998 fourth edition of the Handbook of Social Psychology, volume two, pages 357 through 411.

items.title: 06:26 · Fiske s chapter partitions intergroup responses into
items.detail: Fiske's chapter partitions intergroup responses into three distinct psychological modalities: stereotyping as the cognitive component, prejudice as the affective component, and discrimination as the behavioral component.
